items.title: 拒踩煞車！中國反駁AI放緩呼籲 稱「恐慌論」恐擾亂全球AI治理
items.title_en: Refusing to Hit the Brakes! China Rejects Calls to Slow AI, Calls ‘Panic Talk’ Disruptive to Global AI Governance
paras: 中國政府周一(14日)公開反駁美國AI產業領袖要求放慢尖端人工智能(AI)開發的呼籲，外交部發言人郭嘉昆表示，製造「恐慌」、對抗及競爭只會擾亂全球AI治理進程。這場爭論也進一步凸顯AI已成為中美科技競爭及國家安全角力的核心領域。
中國外交部發言人郭嘉昆周一在北京回應相關提問時表示，美國AI企業高層近期要求放慢AI發展，主要是因為擔心技術快速進步可能帶來的風險。他指出，「恐慌、對抗、競爭」只會干擾全球AI治理進程。
郭嘉昆的表態，是針對Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei、OpenAI執行長Sam Altman及SpaceX執行長Elon Musk近期支持放慢AI開發速度的言論。Amodei周六發表文章，主張AI產業應放慢提升尖端模型能力的速度，以降低快速發展可能帶來的風險。
不過，Amodei同時警告，AI發展不能無限期放慢，因為美國企業目前仍領先以中國為首的「威權政體」。他認為，如果美國AI產業放慢的幅度超過與中國的領先差距，與中國共產黨相關的AI項目可能反超美國，進而形成重大國家安全風險。
中國國家安全部部長陳一新周日也發表文章，呼籲加快建立AI安全風險預防及控制體系。他指出，AI已成為「全球科技競爭的主戰場」，也是主要大國之間戰略競爭的新領域，同時強調需要推動AI「健康、有序」發展。
中國政府的表態正值全球AI相關股票遭遇拋售之際。日本軟銀集團周一股價下跌10%。軟銀是OpenAI的重要投資者之一，AI產業近期對開發速度、資本支出及安全風險的爭論，已開始直接反映在相關股票價格上。
AI發展速度之爭同時與中美之間的技術差距密切相關。美國總統川普日前也警告，美國不能在AI競賽中失去戰略優勢。他在愛爾蘭訪問期間反駁AI企業高層要求放慢開發的主張，表示美國目前領先中國，並希望維持這一優勢，因為「誰贏得AI，誰就贏」。
中國國家主席習近平則在周末於新德里舉行的金磚國家(BRICS)峰會上表示，中國將發揮領導作用，協助推動發展中國家之間的AI合作與發展。這顯示北京正試圖把AI競爭延伸至全球南方市場，透過技術合作擴大中國AI生態系統的國際影響力。
與此同時，中國AI模型在海外企業中的採用程度也逐步提高。隨著中國模型能力持續改善，部分西方企業開始採用中國AI產品，令中美AI技術競爭不再局限於模型性能排名，也延伸至企業應用及全球市場滲透率。
Georgetown Center for Security and Emerging Technology執行董事、前OpenAI董事會成員Helen Toner周一表示，目前最佳估計認為，中國最頂尖AI模型的能力大約落後美國最頂尖模型6至9個月。
Toner指出，如果美國放慢AI發展速度，而中國因為距離美國前沿技術已經相當接近而迅速追上甚至超越，將形成值得關注的問題。不過，她也強調，目前並不清楚中國AI技術的進步有多少來自快速追趕，如果美國前沿AI發展速度放慢，中國的發展速度也可能受到影響而同步放緩。
這場爭論反映AI發展已陷入兩種政策目標之間的拉鋸。一方面，AI能力快速提升可能帶來失控、濫用、網絡攻擊及其他安全風險，因此部分產業領袖希望增加安全測試、監控及風險防範時間；另一方面，若美國單方面放慢技術發展，卻無法確保中國等競爭對手同步放慢，則可能削弱美國在AI及相關國家安全領域的戰略優勢。
對中國而言，北京目前並未釋放放慢AI技術發展的訊號，反而強調加強AI安全治理及推動技術有序發展。這意味著中國政策重點更傾向於在持續推進AI能力的同時建立風險防控體系，而不是以放慢模型開發作為主要手段。
隨著AI成為全球科技、經濟及國家安全競爭的重要支柱，中美兩國對AI發展速度的不同立場，也可能進一步影響未來的晶片需求、AI基礎設施投資、模型商業化及全球AI治理規則。市場目前關注的焦點，已從單純比較模型性能，逐步擴大至AI發展速度、安全風險及地緣政治競爭三個層面。
paras_en: China’s government on Monday (the 14th) publicly rebuffed a call from U.S. AI industry leaders to slow the development of cutting‑edge artificial intelligence (AI). Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said that manufacturing “panic,” confrontation and competition would only disrupt the global AI governance process. The debate further highlights that AI has become a core arena of U.S.-China tech competition and national‑security rivalry.

Guo Jiakun, a spokesperson for China’s Foreign Ministry, responded to questions in Beijing on Monday, noting that senior U.S. AI executives have recently urged a slowdown in AI development mainly because they fear the risks of rapid technological progress. He emphasized that “panic, confrontation, competition” would only interfere with the global AI governance process.

Guo’s remarks were aimed at the recent statements by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, who have all voiced support for slowing the pace of AI development. Amodei published an article on Saturday arguing that the AI industry should decelerate the enhancement of frontier model capabilities to reduce the risks associated with rapid advancement.

However, Amodei also warned that AI development cannot be slowed indefinitely because U.S. firms currently remain ahead of the “authoritarian regimes” led by China. He argued that if the U.S. AI sector slows more than the lead it holds over China, AI projects linked to the Chinese Communist Party could overtake the United States, creating a major national‑security risk.

China’s Minister of State Security Chen Yixin also published an article on Sunday calling for an accelerated establishment of AI safety‑risk prevention and control mechanisms. He noted that AI has become “the main battlefield of global technology competition” and a new arena of strategic rivalry among major powers, stressing the need to promote AI development that is “healthy and orderly.”

The Chinese government’s stance comes as AI‑related stocks worldwide are experiencing sell‑offs. Japan’s SoftBank Group saw its share price fall 10% on Monday. SoftBank is a major investor in OpenAI, and the debate over development speed, capital spending and safety risks in the AI sector has already begun to affect related stock prices directly.

The race over AI development speed is also closely tied to the technology gap between the United States and China. Former U.S. President Donald Trump recently warned that the United States must not lose its strategic advantage in the AI race. While visiting Ireland, he rejected AI executives’ calls to slow development, stating that the U.S. currently leads China and wants to maintain that edge because “whoever wins AI wins.”

Chinese President Xi Jinping told the BRICS summit in New Delhi over the weekend that China will play a leading role in helping promote AI cooperation and development among developing countries. This shows Beijing is trying to extend AI competition into the Global South, expanding the international influence of China’s AI ecosystem through technology cooperation.

At the same time, the adoption of Chinese AI models by overseas firms is gradually increasing. As Chinese model capabilities continue to improve, some Western companies have begun using Chinese AI products, meaning the U.S.-China AI technology contest is no longer limited to model performance rankings but also extends to corporate applications and global market penetration.

Georgetown Center for Security and Emerging Technology executive director and former OpenAI board member Helen Toner said on Monday that the best current estimate puts China’s most advanced AI models about six to nine months behind the United States’ top models.

Toner noted that if the United States slows its AI development while China, being already close to the U.S. frontier, quickly catches up or even overtakes, it would create a concerning situation. However, she also stressed that it is unclear how much of China’s progress is due to rapid catch‑up; if U.S. frontier AI development slows, China’s pace may also be affected and decelerate in tandem.

The debate reflects a tug‑of‑war between two policy objectives. On one hand, rapid AI capability gains could lead to loss of control, misuse, cyber‑attacks and other security risks, prompting some industry leaders to call for longer safety testing, monitoring and risk‑mitigation periods. On the other hand, if the United States unilaterally slows development while competitors such as China do not, it could erode U.S. strategic advantage in AI and related national‑security domains.

For China, Beijing has not signaled any intention to slow AI development; instead it emphasizes strengthening AI safety governance and promoting orderly technological progress. This suggests Chinese policy is more focused on building risk‑control systems while continuing to advance AI capabilities, rather than using a slowdown of model development as a primary tool.

As AI becomes a pillar of global technology, economic and national‑security competition, the differing U.S. and Chinese positions on development speed could further affect future chip demand, AI infrastructure investment, model commercialization and global AI‑governance rules. Market attention is shifting from merely comparing model performance to encompassing AI development speed, safety risks and geopolitical competition.

items.title: 經濟學家警告美股恐暴跌72%！點美股「4階段」走勢預測：先瘋漲、再崩跌
paras: 丹麥經濟學家Henrik Zeberg警告，美國經濟與股市可能正在走向一場劇烈反轉。這名長期研究經濟週期的經濟學家認為，美股可能在2026年底前迎來一波最後的瘋狂上漲，形成所謂「噴出行情」（blow-off top），隨後股市大幅崩跌，美國經濟也將陷入衰退。
Zeberg近期接受《Business Insider》訪問時表示，若其模型預測成真，2026年底前那斯達克100指數可能最高衝上3.9萬點，較目前水準增加約32%，但之後可能一路跌回約1.06萬點，也就是2022年的低點。
若從預測高點計算，這代表那斯達克100可能暴跌約72%，跌幅將接近網路泡沫破裂時的規模。2000年至2002年間，那斯達克100從高點一路重挫83%。
Zeberg表示：「我認為我們會看到2000年的情境，我認為那場崩盤將極具破壞力。」
他指出，AI泡沫一旦破裂，股市劇烈下挫後，金融體系也可能受到波及，包括銀行業及私人信貸市場都可能出現更廣泛的壓力。

Zeberg模型示警：美國經濟正走向收縮

Zeberg目前擔任投資公司Swissblock宏觀策略師，研究經濟週期已有20年。他表示，這套看空論點主要建立在自己打造的經濟模型上，模型透過分析當前經濟狀態，尋找與歷史經濟週期相似的模式。
他指出，該模型曾成功預測2020年經濟下滑，並在2022年市場擔憂衰退時判斷美國不會陷入衰退；如今模型則顯示，美國經濟正朝經濟收縮方向發展。
不過，從近期公布的數據來看，美國經濟表現仍相當強勁。美國8月新增非農就業16.2萬人，大幅超過經濟學家預期；亞特蘭大聯準銀行最新估計則顯示，美國第3季GDP成長率可能加速至4.7%，超過第2季成長速度的3倍。
Zeberg認為，這些亮眼數據可能掩蓋了經濟內部的問題。他指出，高收入族群與中低收入家庭之間的差距日益擴大，使整體經濟表現看起來比實際情況更加強勁。
他主要提出3項警訊。
就業市場表面強勁 勞參率與長期失業率卻亮紅燈
首先是就業市場。儘管8月就業成長明顯優於預期，但Zeberg指出，美國勞動參與率近年整體呈下降趨勢，7月更降至50年低點。
與此同時，長期失業率也持續升高。美國勞工統計局數據顯示，8月失業至少27週的長期失業人口占比達27%。
Zeberg甚至推測，過去一年的部分新增就業數據最終可能遭到大幅下修。他指出，美國去年曾修正數據，顯示2024年4月至2025年3月期間新增就業人數比原先公布的數字少91.1萬人。
房市持續疲弱 成經濟另一項警訊
第二項警訊來自房地產市場。房市通常被視為美國經濟的重要引擎，但疫情後受到房貸利率偏高、房價居高不下及整體經濟不確定性影響，房屋交易持續疲弱。
美國全國房地產經紀人協會（NAR）數據顯示，8月成屋銷售較前月下降2%，與此同時，市場上的待售房屋數量已達10年高點。
Zeberg認為，房市對利率的敏感度高於經濟其他主要領域，因為房屋本質上是一項依賴融資的資產，一旦資金成本上升，房市往往最先受到影響。
中低收入家庭承壓 消費能力恐成弱點
第三項警訊則是美國消費者。Zeberg表示，通膨及借貸成本上升正對更多中低收入美國家庭造成壓力。
Primerica第2季調查顯示，7%的中產階級受訪者表示，收入增幅已落後生活成本；另有58%受訪者表示，無法負擔至少1000美元的緊急支出。
美國個人儲蓄率同樣明顯下降。美國經濟分析局數據顯示，美國民眾7月平均僅將可支配所得的3%存下來，遠低於2021年的9.5%。
Zeberg認為，目前美國經濟的成長很大一部分來自科技產業及高收入族群。惠譽估計，僅資訊科技產業固定投資在第2季就占美國GDP的5%。
談到美國經濟時，Zeberg表示：「這並不是真正的繁榮。」
他認為，企業獲利即使進入衰退期仍可能維持成長，但一旦消費者的經濟狀況惡化，企業也會受到衝擊。

Zeberg預測美股4階段走勢：先瘋漲 再崩跌

Zeberg進一步將未來市場可能出現的變化分成4個階段。
第一階段：瘋狂多頭行情／時間：現在至2026年底
Zeberg預期，美國經濟將持續走弱，但任何偏弱的經濟數據反而可能促使投資人押注聯準會降息，進一步推升股市。
在這種環境下，股市可能出現近乎垂直式的上漲，甚至連加密貨幣及黃金也可能同步走強，而美元則因市場押注降息而走弱。
他預估，在這波行情最後階段，那斯達克100可能升至3.7萬至3.9萬點。
目前市場關注焦點並非降息，而是升息。根據芝商所FedWatch工具，投資人目前押注聯準會在下週政策會議上升息25個基點的機率接近90%。
第二階段：股市見頂／時間：2026年第4季
Zeberg預測，美國經濟可能在10月或11月真正開始轉弱，主要受到就業市場等領域惡化影響，進而迫使聯準會降息，美元也將進一步走弱。
他預估，美元指數可能跌至93至94左右。當美元跌至這一水準後，美股可能同步見頂。
接下來，股市可能在3至4週內出現劇烈下跌，而觸發因素可能只是單一事件，例如大型科技公司財報未達市場預期。
第三階段：股市出現「假反彈」／時間：2027年第1季至第2季
在年底拋售潮後，美股可能暫時重新走高，投資人試圖修復市場下跌造成的損失。
但Zeberg認為，此時美國經濟可能已在「不知不覺中」陷入衰退。短暫反彈過後，股市將重新下跌，美債殖利率也可能快速走低，反映市場開始消化經濟疲弱及聯準會支撐。
與此同時，其他經濟領域可能開始浮現壓力，例如私人信貸市場出現更多貸款價值遭下修，部分基金持續停止贖回。
第四階段：黑天鵝事件／時間：2027年第2季至第3季
Zeberg預期，市場最後可能遭遇一次「黑天鵝」事件，成為全面修正的催化劑。
他認為，金融市場高槓桿，以及AI產業部分交易存在相互融資的循環特性，都可能成為結構性風險來源。
到了這一階段，股市可能一路跌回2022年低點，而全球投資人為尋求美元計價的避險資產，可能推升美元大幅走強。

Zeberg：兩大訊號出現時 投資人應提高警戒

對於投資人何時應該開始降低風險，Zeberg提出兩項值得觀察的市場訊號。
第一是美元指數跌至93至94。他認為，這代表市場對降息的預期已降至可能預示股市接近頂部的程度。
第二是短天期債券殖利率開始快速下跌。這可能代表市場正在迅速反映經濟疲弱及聯準會大幅降息的預期。
不過，Zeberg也表示，如果未來幾個月美債殖利率能在目前水準附近趨於穩定，或者房市及就業市場出現明顯改善，他將重新檢視目前的看法。
Zeberg的預測目前仍屬華爾街較為極端的看法，多數市場預測仍認為AI熱潮至少還能延續數年。
然而，與此同時，愈來愈多投資人開始關注美國經濟的實際韌性，尤其當油價重新突破每桶100美元，通膨壓力再度升溫，市場對經濟前景的疑慮也隨之增加。

items.title: 一艘油輪穿越荷姆茲觸雷爆炸 伊朗革命衛隊重申已封鎖
items.title_en: Oil Tanker Hits Mine in Strait of Hormuz, Explodes; Iran's Revolutionary Guard Reaffirms Closure
paras: 一艘巴拿馬籍成品油輪週一 (14 日) 深夜在荷姆茲海峽南部觸雷後爆炸起火，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊海軍隨後重申，荷姆茲海峽仍處於關閉狀態。與此同時，美國傳出尋求與伊朗達成「分階段」協議，國際油價一度回落，但區域外交會議延期、沙烏地阿拉伯輸油管線停擺，以及葉門胡塞武裝擴大控制紅海沿岸，顯示中東能源運輸風險仍未解除。
據伊朗《法斯通訊社》報導，這艘名為EL GAIA、國際海事組織編號9325336的超級油輪，試圖駛入荷姆茲海峽南部未經批准的區域，撞上海上水雷後發生爆炸。
報導稱，滅火行動未能控制火勢，船隻仍遭烈焰吞噬。伊朗革命衛隊表示，先前已就船隻違規通行的危險發出警告，並重申荷姆茲海峽已經關閉。
若相關說法獲得證實，將與美國總統川普先前宣稱海峽水雷已全面清除的說法相左。
川普8月曾表示，荷姆茲海峽國際水域內的水雷均已引爆或移除，並警告伊朗，任何繼續布雷的船隻都將遭到摧毀。
美傳尋求分階段協議 伊朗否認主動求和
就在荷姆茲海峽再傳油輪事故之際，伊朗勞工通訊社引述巴基斯坦消息人士報導，美國正尋求與伊朗達成「分階段」協議，可能為雙方重返談判鋪路，但華府暫時不會放棄軍事與經濟壓力。
談判消息傳出後，國際油價一度降至盤中低點，布蘭特原油回落至每桶106美元附近。不過，伊朗仍否認正主動尋求與美國展開新一輪談判。
原定週一在阿曼南部城市塞拉萊舉行的波斯灣沿岸國家外長會議，也已延後且未公布新日期。原計畫與會者包括伊朗、阿曼、伊拉克、沙烏地阿拉伯、阿拉伯聯合大公國、科威特及卡達外長。
巴林拒絕參加會議，主張區域穩定不能依靠綏靖政策維持，並要求荷姆茲海峽在沒有差別待遇、收費或許可制度下重新開放。
這場會議原本將討論由伊朗與阿曼共同管理荷姆茲海峽船舶通行的方案。
伊朗外交部官員Mohammad Ali Bak表示，應部分區域國家要求，阿曼與伊朗共同決定將會議延後。
若會議最終舉行，將是2月28日戰爭爆發以來，伊朗與波斯灣合作理事會成員國高階外交官首度齊聚。伊朗外長阿拉奇 (Abbas Araqchi)先前表示，會中將提出船隻進出海峽的航線圖與相關細節，但也強調，這項方案本身不足以讓海峽重新開放。
胡塞武裝跨境攻擊沙國基地 擴張紅海控制範圍
另一邊，葉門胡塞武裝宣稱，已向沙烏地阿拉伯南部海米斯穆謝特的哈立德國王空軍基地發射數十枚彈道飛彈及無人機，鎖定軍事基礎設施、武器庫與指揮控制中心。
胡塞武裝表示，這項「大規模軍事行動」直接命中基地並造成嚴重破壞，是為報復沙烏地阿拉伯過去一週對葉門發動逾300次空襲。不過，相關損害程度尚未獲得獨立核實。
哈立德國王空軍基地過去曾供美英先進戰機使用，並設有防護強化的機庫，但目前是否仍部署西方軍事資產尚不清楚。
獲國際承認的葉門政府則表示，政府軍週日對塔伊茲地區的胡塞武裝據點發動3次空襲，沙烏地阿拉伯邊境附近的薩達省也傳出砲擊。
胡塞武裝上週奪取葉門西部其餘沿岸地區，並控制位於曼德海峽內的丕林島，進一步擴大對紅海航道的影響力。新控制區距離位於吉布地的美軍基地僅約32公里。
胡塞武裝表示，封鎖行動只針對與沙烏地阿拉伯有關的船隻，是為報復沙烏地聯軍封鎖胡塞控制區。然而，多家全球貨運業者仍對通過曼德海峽抱持戒心，部分船隻已改道非洲好望角，使航程至少增加20天並推高運輸成本。
沙烏地阿拉伯王儲穆罕默德．沙爾曼(Mohammed bin Salman) 週一在吉達會見美國中央司令部司令Brad Cooper，但川普迄今仍不願讓美國直接軍事介入葉門局勢。
沙國東西向輸油管線停擺 油價維持百美元上方
中東能源供應的另一項重大風險，來自沙烏地阿拉伯東西向輸油管線。該管線一座泵站遭源自伊拉克的無人機攻擊後，已於週末全面關閉，目前尚無恢復運作的明確時間。
由於荷姆茲海峽航運受阻，這條管線原本肩負將沙國原油輸送至紅海沿岸延布港的重任，是沙烏地阿拉伯繞過海峽出口石油的重要替代路線。
沙國石油交易商表示，若管線無法在數日內恢復，沙烏地阿拉伯的出口庫存可能耗盡，最多可使相當於全球供應量4%的原油退出市場。沙國原油庫存即使在泵站遇襲前，也已降至30年來最低水準。
沙烏地阿拉伯最初表示，關閉管線只是預防措施，但有消息人士預估，修復工程可能耗時5至6週。
在供應中斷疑慮支撐下，西德州原油期貨週一收漲1.3%至每桶101.39美元；布蘭特原油上漲1.0%，收每桶105.68美元。
paras_en: A Panama-flagged product tanker exploded and caught fire late Monday (the 14th) after striking a mine in the southern Strait of Hormuz. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) navy subsequently reiterated that the strait remains closed. At the same time, reports emerged that the United States is seeking a “phased” agreement with Iran, briefly pulling down international oil prices, but a postponed regional diplomatic meeting, a shutdown of Saudi Arabia’s oil pipeline, and the Houthi militia’s expanding control of the Red Sea coast all indicate that Middle‑East energy‑transport risks have not been eliminated.

According to Iran’s Fars News Agency, the super‑tanker named EL GAIA, IMO number 9325336, attempted to enter an unapproved area of the southern Strait of Hormuz and detonated after hitting a sea mine.

The report said fire‑fighting efforts failed to contain the blaze and the vessel remained engulfed in flames. The IRGC said it had previously warned of the danger posed by the ship’s illegal passage and reiterated that the Strait of Hormuz is closed.
If these statements are verified, they would contradict former U.S. President Donald Trump’s claim that all mines in the strait’s international waters had been cleared.

In August, Trump asserted that all mines in the international waters of the Strait of Hormuz had been detonated or removed and warned Iran that any ship that continued to lay mines would be destroyed.
U.S. Seeks Phased Deal; Iran Denies Initiating Peace Talks

Amid the renewed tanker incident in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran’s Labor News Agency cited Pakistani sources saying the United States is seeking a “phased” agreement with Iran that could pave the way for renewed negotiations, though Washington will not abandon military and economic pressure for now.

After the negotiation news broke, international oil prices briefly fell to intraday lows, with Brent crude slipping to around $106 a barrel. Iran, however, continues to deny that it is actively seeking a new round of talks with the United States.

The foreign‑ministers’ meeting of Gulf states that was scheduled for Monday in Salalah, southern Oman, has been postponed with no new date announced. Participants were to include the foreign ministers of Iran, Oman, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait and Qatar.

Bahrain refused to attend, arguing that regional stability cannot rely on appeasement policies and demanding that the Strait of Hormuz be reopened without discrimination, fees or licensing requirements.
The meeting was originally to discuss a joint Iran‑Oman management scheme for vessel traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.
Iranian foreign‑ministry official Mohammad Ali Bak said the postponement was at the request of some regional countries, with Oman and Iran jointly deciding to delay the summit.

If the summit eventually takes place, it will be the first gathering since the war erupted on Feb. 28 of senior diplomats from Iran and members of the Persian Gulf Cooperation Council. Iran’s foreign minister Abbas Araqchi had previously said the meeting would present a navigation chart and details for ships transiting the strait, but he also stressed that the proposal alone would not be enough to reopen the waterway.
Houthi Forces Launch Cross‑Border Attack on Saudi Base, Expand Red Sea Control

Elsewhere, Yemen’s Houthi militia claimed it fired dozens of ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia’s King Khalid Air Base in the southern city of Hemeimah, targeting military facilities, ammunition depots and command‑control centers.

The Houthis said the “large‑scale military operation” directly hit the base and caused serious damage as retaliation for more than 300 Saudi airstrikes on Yemen in the past week. The extent of the damage has not been independently verified.
King Khalid Air Base has previously hosted advanced U.S. and British aircraft and features hardened hangars, but it is unclear whether Western assets are still stationed there.

The internationally recognised Yemeni government said its forces carried out three airstrikes on Houthi positions in the Taiz region on Sunday, and artillery fire was reported near Saudi Arabia’s border in the Sadah province.

Last week the Houthis seized the remaining coastal areas of western Yemen and took control of Birin Island in the Bab al‑Mandeb, further extending their influence over Red Sea shipping lanes. The new area lies only about 32 km from the U.S. base in Djibouti.

The Houthis said the blockade targets only vessels linked to Saudi Arabia as retaliation for the Saudi‑led coalition’s blockade of Houthi‑held zones. Nevertheless, many global shippers remain wary of transiting the Bab al‑Mandeb, with some ships rerouting around Africa’s Cape of Good Hope, adding at least 20 days to voyages and raising freight costs.
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met U.S. Central Command commander Brad Cooper in Jeddah on Monday, but Trump still refuses to allow direct U.S. military involvement in Yemen.
Saudi Arabia’s East‑West oil pipeline is offline, keeping crude prices above $100 a barrel

Another major risk to Middle‑East energy supply comes from Saudi Arabia’s east‑west oil pipeline. A pump station was hit by a drone launched from Iraq and the line has been completely shut down since the weekend, with no clear timeline for resumption.

Because Hormuz shipping is disrupted, the pipeline—normally responsible for moving Saudi crude to the Red Sea port of Yanbu—has become a crucial alternative route for oil that would otherwise have to exit via the strait.

Saudi oil traders warn that if the pipeline cannot be restored within days, Saudi export inventories could be exhausted, potentially removing up to 4 % of global oil supply from the market. Even before the pump‑station attack, Saudi crude stocks were at their lowest level in 30 years.
Saudi Arabia initially said the shutdown was a precautionary measure, but sources estimate repairs could take five to six weeks.
Supported by supply‑disruption concerns, West Texas Intermediate futures rose 1.3 % on Monday to $101.39 a barrel, while Brent climbed 1.0 % to $105.68 a barrel.

items.title: 為何美債殖利率達5%讓投資者恐慌？專家示警恐衝擊股市、AI投資成本也將升高
items.title_en: Why a 5% U.S. Treasury Yield Sends Investors Into a Panic: Experts Warn It Could Hit the Stock Market and Raise AI Investment Costs
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率再度逼近5%關卡，重新引發投資人對美債殖利率攀升可能衝擊股市及金融市場的擔憂。雖然5%本身並非具有特殊意義的絕對門檻，但由於近年10年期美債殖利率鮮少突破這一水準，市場已將其視為重要警戒線。
根據《Business Insider》報導，殖利率在美國8月通膨數據公布後一度回落，但隨後再度走高。10年期美債殖利率週一（1４日）升至4.95%，距離5%僅剩5個基點。
ING美洲區研究主管Padhraic Garvey表示，10年期美債殖利率之所以受到市場高度關注，主要是因為近代很少突破5%水準。
除了2023年曾出現短暫的債市劇烈波動外，上一次10年期美債殖利率突破5%是在2007年，也就是全球金融危機爆發前幾個月。
盈透證券資深經濟學家Jose Torres指出，市場交易員往往會特別關注整數關卡，一旦突破5%，下一個市場關注點可能就會轉向5.5%甚至6%。在全球金融危機後的經濟環境下，如此高的殖利率可能對金融市場形成難以承受的壓力。
目前20年期及30年期美債殖利率都已突破5%，但10年期公債仍具有更高的市場影響力，原因在於其殖利率更直接牽動房貸、企業貸款等借貸成本，因此受到投資人更多關注。
10年期美債殖利率走高，首先意味著整體融資成本可能持續上升。
Garvey指出，當10年期殖利率觸及5%，市場會立即聯想到房貸利率及企業融資成本進一步增加。
房地美（Freddie Mac）數據顯示，上週，美國30年期固定房貸平均利率為6.76%，今年以來已上升60個基點；同期10年期美債殖利率則累計上升76個基點。
企業借貸成本同樣走高。反映企業借貸成本的ICE BofA 美國高收益債券指數的有效殖利率上週升至7.42%，今年以來增加89個基點。
對股市而言，10年期美債殖利率持續走高的另一層風險，在於無風險利率上升可能降低股票等風險資產的吸引力。
匯豐銀行今年稍早發布給客戶的報告便指出，從殖利率對股市的影響來看，當前水準已明顯進入「危險區」。
Garvey表示，如果10年期美債殖利率突破5%，金融市場確實可能承受壓力，甚至可能導致風險資產出現明顯回落。
不過，他強調，殖利率「上升的速度」可能比單純突破某個數字更加重要。
他指出，10年期美債殖利率近期從4.5%附近快速上升，本身就是值得關注的現象。若殖利率持續以這樣的速度攀升，市場可能尋找理由回吐部分近期漲幅，讓股市從高點回落。

美債殖利率5%恐與企業債「搶資金」 AI投資面臨壓力

除了對股市及一般借貸成本的影響，10年期美債殖利率升至5%，也可能帶來另一項市場擔憂：美國公債與企業債券之間的資金競爭。
Torres指出，這項問題尤其可能影響目前高度依賴債務融資的AI產業。
AI業者正投入大量資金建設相關基礎設施，而企業需要透過債券等固定收益市場籌措資金。當美國公債殖利率持續升高，公債對固定收益投資人的吸引力也可能提高，使AI企業必須面對更高的融資成本。
這項變化也可能進一步影響AI投資的經濟效益。市場目前本已關注AI企業投入龐大資本支出後，最終能否取得相應報酬；若融資成本同步上升，相關投資計畫的成本效益可能面臨更大壓力。
Torres認為，在財政與通膨疑慮持續存在的情況下，美債市場目前承受相當大的壓力。他認為，若要讓殖利率出現具有意義的下降，可能需要伊朗戰爭問題獲得長期解決，或聯準會（Fed）重新大規模實施量化寬鬆，例如將約500億美元的美債納入資產負債表。
市場目前的關注點已不只是10年期美債能否突破5%，而是突破後是否可能進一步走高。Garvey認為，10年期美債殖利率近期存在升至6%的可能性。若真的達到6%，將創下2000年以來最高水準。
他尤其警告，若殖利率在未來幾個月內快速從5%升至6%，將成為金融市場相當棘手的情境。
paras_en: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields are once again approaching the 5% threshold, reigniting investor concerns that rising yields could impact equities and financial markets. While 5% itself is not a special absolute barrier, the level has been rarely breached in recent years, leading the market to treat it as a key warning line.

According to Business Insider, yields fell briefly after the U.S. August inflation data were released but then rose again. On Monday the 14th, the 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 4.95%, just five basis points shy of 5%.
ING’s head of Americas research, Padhraic Garvey, said the 10-year Treasury is closely watched because modern markets have seldom seen it break the 5% mark.
Aside from a brief period of sharp bond‑market turbulence in 2023, the last time the 10-year Treasury topped 5% was in 2007, just months before the global financial crisis erupted.

Interactive Brokers senior economist Jose Torres noted that traders tend to focus on round numbers; once 5% is breached, attention may shift to 5.5% or even 6%. In the post‑crisis economic environment, such high yields could place unsustainable pressure on financial markets.

While 20‑year and 30‑year Treasury yields have already passed 5%, the 10-year remains more influential because its yield directly affects mortgage and corporate loan costs, drawing greater investor focus.
A rising 10-year Treasury yield first signals that overall financing costs may continue to climb.
Garvey added that when the 10-year hits 5%, the market instantly links it to higher mortgage rates and corporate financing costs.

Freddie Mac data show that last week the average rate on a 30‑year fixed U.S. mortgage was 6.76%, up 60 basis points year‑to‑date; over the same period the 10-year Treasury yield has risen a cumulative 76 basis points.
Corporate borrowing costs are also climbing. The effective yield on the ICE BofA U.S. High‑Yield Index rose to 7.42% last week, up 89 basis points since the start of the year.
For equities, another risk of a persistently rising 10-year Treasury is that higher risk‑free rates can make stocks and other risk assets less attractive.
HSBC’s early‑year client report warned that, from the perspective of yield impact on equities, current levels have clearly entered a “danger zone.”
Garvey said that if the 10-year Treasury breaches 5%, financial markets could indeed feel pressure, potentially prompting a noticeable pullback in risk assets.
However, he emphasized that the speed of yield increases may matter more than simply crossing a specific number.

He pointed out that the recent rapid climb from around 4.5% to current levels is itself noteworthy. If yields keep rising at this pace, the market may look for reasons to roll back some of the recent gains, causing stocks to retreat from highs.
A 5% Treasury yield could spark competition for capital with corporate bonds, putting pressure on AI investment costs.
Torres noted that this issue could especially affect the AI sector, which currently relies heavily on debt financing.

AI firms are pouring large sums into building related infrastructure and need to raise money through bonds and other fixed‑income markets. As U.S. Treasury yields rise, Treasuries become more attractive to fixed‑income investors, forcing AI companies to face higher financing costs.

This shift could further affect the economics of AI investment. The market is already watching whether AI firms’ massive capex will generate commensurate returns; higher financing costs would increase the cost‑benefit pressure on those projects.

Torres believes that with ongoing fiscal and inflation concerns, the Treasury market is under considerable strain. He argues that a meaningful yield decline would likely require a long‑term resolution of the Iran war issue or a renewed large‑scale Fed quantitative easing, such as adding roughly $50 billion of Treasuries to its balance sheet.

Market focus has moved beyond whether the 10-year Treasury will break 5% to whether it will climb further after that. Garvey sees a possibility of the 10-year reaching 6% in the near term, which would be the highest level since 2000.
He warns that a rapid jump from 5% to 6% within months would create a particularly tricky scenario for financial markets.

items.title: 川普：俄羅斯、烏克蘭同意不打對方能源目標
items.title_en: Trump: Russia and Ukraine Agree Not to Attack Each Other's Energy Targets
paras: 在全球能源價格飆漲之際，美國總統川普周一（14日）宣布，烏克蘭政府已經同意美國提出的要求，即停止襲擊俄羅斯境內能源設施，俄羅斯也同意採取同樣做法。
特朗普當天在社交媒體上發文：「烏克蘭已經同意不再襲擊俄羅斯能源目標。俄羅斯也同意這樣做！」他說，全球柴油價格上漲主要是由烏克蘭戰爭引起，不是伊朗問題。
顯然，能源價格走高正給美國共和黨帶來政治壓力，川普正試圖通過公開喊話，推動結束這場由戰爭引發的能源價格困局。
克里姆林宮周一對川普呼籲烏克蘭停止襲擊俄羅斯柴油生產設施表示歡迎，同時表示，全球能源市場近期波動主要是波斯灣衝突引起。
川普上周日已向澤倫斯基政府施壓，他表示，澤倫斯基「必須做一件事，就是停止摧毀俄羅斯的柴油生產設施」。
川普提到：「還有很多其他目標可以打，但不要襲擊柴油生產設施，因為這造成傷害，傷害整個世界。」他表示，確實已經就此事與澤倫斯基溝通。
近幾個月來，烏克蘭持續發動一系列遠程無人機襲擊，目標直指俄羅斯煉油廠，導致俄羅斯燃料產量下降，並引發全國燃料短缺。
paras_en: Amid soaring global energy prices, U.S. President Donald Trump announced on Monday (the 14th) that the Ukrainian government has agreed to the U.S. request to stop attacking energy facilities inside Russia, and Russia has likewise agreed to do the same.

Trump posted on social media that day: "Ukraine has agreed not to attack Russian energy targets. Russia has agreed to do the same!" He said the rise in global diesel prices is mainly caused by the war in Ukraine, not by Iran.
Clearly, rising energy prices are creating political pressure on the U.S. Republican Party, and Trump is trying to push an end to the war‑driven energy price squeeze by publicly calling for it.

The Kremlin on Monday welcomed Trump’s appeal for Ukraine to stop striking Russian diesel production facilities and said recent volatility in global energy markets is mainly caused by conflicts in the Persian Gulf.
Trump pressed the Zelensky administration last Sunday, stating that Zelensky "must do one thing: stop destroying Russia’s diesel production facilities."

Trump added: "There are many other targets that could be hit, but do not attack diesel production facilities, because that harms the whole world." He said he has indeed communicated this with Zelensky.
In recent months, Ukraine has continued a series of long‑range drone attacks aimed at Russian refineries, causing a drop in Russia’s fuel output and sparking nationwide fuel shortages.

items.title: 輝達對Anthropic踩煞車！Fable只准碰低敏感工作、核心業務改用自家AI
items.title_en: Nvidia Slams the Brakes on Anthropic! Fable Restricted to Low‑Sensitivity Tasks, Core Operations Switch to In‑House AI
paras: 企業採用最先進人工智慧模型的態度正出現變化。《The Information》報導，輝達(NVDA-US) 、Palantir(PLTR-US) 及博思艾倫(BAH-US) 近期均限制使用Anthropic旗艦模型Fable，主因是Anthropic自6月起要求以30天滾動方式保留部分客戶使用紀錄，引發企業對內部程式碼、智慧財產權與敏感資料可能遭模型供應商接觸的疑慮。
其中，輝達並未全面停用Fable，而是採取分級使用策略，僅將Fable用於開源軟體等敏感度較低的任務，涉及供應鏈監控等核心業務則改採自家Nemotron模型。
這波企業限制措施也顯示，企業AI市場的競爭焦點，正從單純追求模型性能，逐漸轉向資料控制與安全治理。
30天資料留存政策引爆疑慮
爭議源自Anthropic今年6月推出Claude Fable 5時同步調整資料政策。根據新規，所有使用Fable及Mythos系列模型的客戶，其提示詞與模型輸出內容都必須至少保留30天，作為安全審查用途。
Anthropic解釋，隨著Fable能力大幅提升，模型可能被用於網路攻擊、生物風險或竊取訓練資料等高風險用途，單靠一次對話不足以發現複雜攻擊，因此需要跨會話、跨帳戶進行關聯分析，才能辨識更複雜的異常模式。
這項政策不只適用於Anthropic自有平台，也涵蓋AWS Bedrock、Google Cloud及Microsoft Foundry等管道。更重要的是，原本已與Anthropic談妥零資料保留（Zero Data Retention，ZDR）協議的企業客戶，同樣受到新政策影響。
ZDR一直是金融、醫療、國防等高度重視資料安全的企業採用AI模型時的重要條件，核心概念是客戶送交模型處理的資料在完成運算後即刪除，不進行儲存，也不被用於後續模型訓練。Anthropic的新政策因此直接觸及部分大型企業的資料治理紅線。
輝達核心業務改用Nemotron
面對新的資料留存規範，輝達採取分層隔離方式因應。敏感度較低的工作仍可使用Fable，但涉及供應鏈監控等重要內部資訊的業務，則全面切換至自家的Nemotron模型。
換言之，輝達並非完全封鎖Anthropic模型，而是依照資料敏感程度決定哪些工作可以交由Fable處理。開源軟體等不涉及核心商業機密的任務仍可使用Fable，但真正涉及企業核心營運資訊的工作，則不再交由Anthropic的模型處理。
博思艾倫的限制更為明確。該公司禁止員工在涉及交付客戶的專有網路安全軟體工作中使用商業版Fable，主要擔憂內部程式碼被納入Anthropic的資料留存範圍。
博思艾倫技術長Bill Vass直言，公司擔心Fable可能「學走」內部程式碼。部分國防、能源及製藥企業也開始轉向自有伺服器或不連網環境部署模型，以降低敏感資料進入外部AI供應商系統的風險。
Palantir要求「不可撤銷」零資料保留
Palantir則選擇直接暫停透過自家平台向客戶提供Fable，並要求Anthropic對旗下模型提供不可撤銷的ZDR承諾。在Anthropic提供符合要求的承諾以前，Fable不會重新透過Palantir平台提供給客戶。
Palantir本身是將AI模型提供給政府及大型企業的重要平台，因此對資料控制條件格外敏感。該公司此前曾與Anthropic協商，希望取得涵蓋所有模型、且不可撤銷的ZDR承諾，但Anthropic 6月推出的新資料政策，使原有安排受到影響。
相較之下，Palantir目前已在ZDR條件下取得OpenAI GPT-6 Astra的使用權。這也意味著，對企業客戶而言，模型性能已不再是唯一考量，供應商願意提供什麼樣的資料處理條件，也可能直接左右企業選擇哪一家AI模型。
《The Information》報導還指出，微軟(MSFT-US) 內部也曾限制員工使用Fable；一家大型美國公用事業公司原本計劃使用Fable測試核心電力基礎設施，但由於無法取得不可撤銷的零資料保留保證，最終取消相關計畫。
Anthropic安全報告反讓企業提高警覺
企業疑慮進一步升高，與Anthropic近期發布的威脅情報報告有關。Anthropic原本希望透過報告展示自身偵測AI濫用及安全威脅的能力，包括如何發現未經授權的模型蒸餾、辨識規避安全分類器的操作，以及從跨帳戶的大規模資料中尋找異常模式。
其中一項對齊評估掃描約4.81億筆互動紀錄。Anthropic藉此說明，大規模資料分析有助於辨識複雜的惡意行為。
然而，部分企業從這份報告看到的卻是另一層問題：模型供應商在技術上具有存取、儲存及審查大量客戶資料的能力。
即使Anthropic承諾不會依預設條款使用企業客戶的輸入及輸出內容訓練模型，只要資料進入第三方雲端平台，就可能離開企業直接控制範圍，並存在人工複核的可能性。對金融、醫療、國防及關鍵基礎設施等高度敏感產業而言，這成為難以忽視的風險。
Anthropic推出新方案回應企業需求
面對大型企業反彈，Anthropic隨後推出「企業前沿安全保障」（EFS）方案，允許符合資格的企業將資料儲存在自己的雲端環境，並由客戶自行持有金鑰，Anthropic系統則負責掃描濫用訊號，再交由客戶審核。
Anthropic表示，這套方案是與100多家金融、醫療及電信領域客戶共同建立，其中包括多名資訊安全長（CISO）。Anthropic也承認，對受到高度監管的產業而言，需要保留資料的模型確實較難採用。
不過，EFS目前採邀請制，預計到秋季才分階段上線，而且部分模型仍不適用。另一個關鍵問題在於，Anthropic保留取消這項選項的權利，與Palantir要求的「不可撤銷」ZDR仍存在差距。
對大型企業而言，能否長期掌握資料處理權限，是導入AI系統的重要前提。如果供應商可以日後改變資料保留政策，即使現階段提供較嚴格的隱私方案，企業仍可能擔心未來的資料治理規則再次改變。
AI競爭從模型性能轉向資料控制
Anthropic與企業客戶之間的爭議，也反映生成式AI進入企業核心業務後的新矛盾。對模型供應商而言，保留一定程度的使用紀錄有助於辨識攻擊、濫用與規避安全機制的行為；但對企業而言，同一套資料留存機制卻可能讓最敏感的程式碼、智慧財產權及商業資訊離開自身控制。
這也使企業開始重新評估使用外部AI模型的方式。部分公司選擇依資料敏感程度分級使用不同模型，部分要求更嚴格的ZDR條款，也有國防、能源及製藥企業轉向自有伺服器或不連網環境部署模型。
輝達的做法正是這種趨勢的縮影：Fable仍可處理敏感度較低的工作，但涉及供應鏈監控等核心業務時，則改用自家Nemotron模型。
隨著AI逐步深入企業營運，模型是否最強已不是唯一決策標準。企業能否控制資料存放位置、供應商能保留多少資訊，以及相關承諾是否可以被日後撤銷，正逐漸成為大型企業選擇AI供應商時的重要考量。
Anthropic這波資料政策引發的反彈，也顯示企業AI競爭正在從模型能力，進一步延伸至資料主權與安全治理。
paras_en: Companies' attitudes toward adopting the most advanced AI models are shifting. The Information reported that Nvidia (NVDA-US), Palantir (PLTR-US) and Booz Allen Hamilton (BAH-US) have recently limited use of Anthropic's flagship model Fable, mainly because Anthropic began requiring a rolling 30‑day retention of some customer usage records starting in June, raising concerns that internal code, intellectual property and sensitive data could be accessed by the model provider.

Nvidia has not completely disabled Fable; instead it is employing a tiered usage strategy, restricting Fable to lower‑sensitivity tasks such as open‑source software work, while core operations like supply‑chain monitoring are being handled with its own Nemotron model.
These corporate restrictions also show that the competitive focus in the enterprise AI market is moving away from pure model performance toward data control and security governance.
30‑Day Data Retention Policy Sparks Concerns

The controversy stems from Anthropic's June rollout of Claude Fable 5, which was accompanied by a change to its data policy. Under the new rule, all customers using Fable and the Mythos series must retain prompts and model outputs for at least 30 days for safety‑review purposes.

Anthropic explained that as Fable’s capabilities have grown dramatically, the model could be used for high‑risk activities such as cyber‑attacks, bio‑risk scenarios, or training‑data theft. A single conversation is insufficient to detect complex attacks, so cross‑session and cross‑account correlation analysis is needed to spot more sophisticated anomalous patterns.

The policy applies not only to Anthropic’s own platform but also to channels like AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry. More importantly, enterprise customers who had previously negotiated Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreements are also affected by the new rule.

ZDR has long been a critical condition for highly regulated sectors such as finance, healthcare and defense, where the core principle is that data submitted to a model is deleted immediately after processing, not stored or used for future training. Anthropic’s new policy therefore directly breaches the data‑governance red line for many large firms.
Nvidia Switches Core Operations to Nemotron

Facing the new data‑retention requirement, Nvidia is adopting a layered isolation approach. Lower‑sensitivity work can still use Fable, but any business involving critical internal information such as supply‑chain monitoring is being fully migrated to Nvidia’s own Nemotron model.

In other words, Nvidia is not outright blocking Anthropic models; it decides which tasks can be handled by Fable based on data sensitivity. Open‑source software and other non‑core tasks remain eligible for Fable, while work that touches core operational data is no longer processed by Anthropic’s model.

Booz Allen’s restriction is even clearer. The firm bans employees from using the commercial version of Fable on proprietary network‑security software projects for clients, fearing that internal code could fall within Anthropic’s data‑retention scope.

Booz Allen’s CTO Bill Vass said the company worries that Fable might “learn” internal code. Some defense, energy and pharmaceutical companies are also moving to on‑premise servers or air‑gapped environments to reduce the risk of sensitive data reaching external AI providers.
Palantir Demands Irrevocable Zero‑Data Retention

Palantir has chosen to suspend offering Fable to its customers via its own platform and is demanding that Anthropic provide an irrevocable ZDR commitment for its models. Until Anthropic supplies a satisfactory pledge, Fable will not be re‑offered through Palantir’s platform.

Palantir, a major AI‑model provider for governments and large enterprises, is especially sensitive to data‑control terms. The company previously negotiated with Anthropic for a blanket, irrevocable ZDR guarantee across all models, but Anthropic’s June data‑policy change disrupted that arrangement.

By contrast, Palantir has already secured usage rights for OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra under ZDR conditions. This indicates that for enterprise customers, model performance is no longer the sole consideration; the data‑handling terms a vendor offers can directly influence which AI model a company selects.

The Information also noted that Microsoft (MSFT‑US) internally restricted employee use of Fable; a large U.S. utility had planned to test Fable on core power‑grid infrastructure but cancelled the project after being unable to obtain an irrevocable zero‑data‑retention guarantee.
Anthropic’s Safety Report Raises Corporate Alarm Bells

Corporate concerns have risen further in light of Anthropic’s recent threat‑intelligence report. Anthropic originally aimed to showcase its ability to detect AI misuse and security threats, including unauthorized model distillation, evasion of safety classifiers, and spotting anomalous patterns across large, cross‑account datasets.
One assessment scanned roughly 481 million interaction records. Anthropic used this to illustrate how massive data analysis can help identify complex malicious behavior.
However, some firms saw another issue in the report: model providers technically possess the ability to access, store and review vast amounts of customer data.

Even though Anthropic pledges not to use enterprise customers’ inputs and outputs for training under default terms, once data passes through a third‑party cloud platform it may leave the enterprise’s direct control and be subject to human review. For highly sensitive sectors such as finance, healthcare, defense and critical infrastructure, this risk is hard to ignore.
Anthropic Launches New Offering to Meet Enterprise Demands

In response to the backlash, Anthropic introduced an “Enterprise Frontier Security” (EFS) solution that lets qualified companies store data in their own cloud environments, retain the encryption keys themselves, while Anthropic’s system scans for abuse signals and hands the findings to the customer for review.

Anthropic said the solution was co‑developed with over 100 financial, healthcare and telecom customers, including several chief information security officers. The company also acknowledged that for heavily regulated industries, models that retain data are indeed harder to adopt.

EFS is currently invitation‑only, slated for phased rollout in the fall, and some models will remain ineligible. A key concern is that Anthropic retains the right to discontinue the option, which still falls short of Palantir’s demand for an “irrevocable” ZDR commitment.

For large enterprises, long‑term control over data‑processing rights is a prerequisite for AI adoption. If a vendor can later change its data‑retention policy, even a presently strict privacy offering may not allay worries about future governance rule shifts.
AI Competition Shifts From Model Performance to Data Control

The dispute between Anthropic and its corporate clients highlights a new tension as generative AI moves into core business functions. Model providers benefit from retaining usage logs to detect attacks, abuse and security‑evasion behavior; enterprises, however, see the same retention mechanisms as a pathway for their most sensitive code, IP and commercial information to leave their control.

This has prompted companies to reassess how they use external AI models. Some segment workloads by data sensitivity and assign different models accordingly, others demand stricter ZDR clauses, and defense, energy and pharma firms are shifting to on‑premise or air‑gapped deployments.
Nvidia’s approach epitomizes this trend: Fable remains usable for lower‑sensitivity tasks, but core activities such as supply‑chain monitoring are handled with Nvidia’s own Nemotron model.

As AI becomes more embedded in corporate operations, raw model superiority is no longer the sole decision factor. Enterprises increasingly weigh where their data resides, how much information a vendor can retain, and whether related commitments can be revoked later, all of which are becoming key criteria when selecting an AI supplier.
The backlash to Anthropic’s data‑policy shift underscores that AI competition among enterprises is moving beyond model capability toward data sovereignty and security governance.

items.title: 沙國關鍵輸油管線遇襲受損 主力運力恐停運數周
items.title_en: Saudi Arabia's Key Oil Pipeline Damaged in Attack, Main Capacity May Be Halted for Weeks
paras: 據《美聯社》報導，兩名地區官員透露，沙烏地阿拉伯一條關鍵輸油管線在上周的襲擊中受損，受維修作業影響，該管線主力運力將停運數周。
橫貫沙國全境的東西輸油管線是沙國石油出口戰略的核心設施。沙國正將石油出口航線轉向紅海，以此規避波斯灣荷姆茲海峽的航運風險，該海域因伊朗襲擊事件航運受阻。
這條全長1,200公里的管線，最大日輸油量可達700萬桶。
沙國方面表示，此次襲擊由伊朗支持的伊拉克民兵動用無人機發起，受襲擊影響，該管線已於上周四被迫關停。
知情官員說，管線及一處主要泵站的受損維修工作，預計耗時3至5周。其中一名官員表示，維修期間管線可能可維持部分運力運行。
據《彭博》周一（14日）報導，Sparta Commodities SA高級石油市場分析師June Goh表示，「歸根結底，一切都取決於停運持續多久。」
Goh稱，如果原油運輸能夠迅速恢復，那麼影響應該較為有限，因為現在可以動用位於管線西端的延布庫存。但她指出，如果停運持續較長時間，沙國可能會被迫削減產量。
DBS銀行能源研究主管Suvro Sarkar表示，沙國延布的庫存可以支撐5至7天的出口，但如果輸油管線停運時間超過這一期限，將造成「巨大干擾」。
paras_en: According to the Associated Press, two regional officials said a crucial oil pipeline in Saudi Arabia was damaged in an attack last week, and maintenance work will cause the pipeline’s main capacity to be shut down for several weeks.

The east‑west pipeline that spans the entire country is a core facility for Saudi oil export strategy. Saudi Arabia is shifting its export routes to the Red Sea to avoid shipping risks in the Persian Gulf’s Hormuz Strait, where traffic has been disrupted by Iranian attacks.
The 1,200‑kilometre pipeline can transport up to 7 million barrels of oil per day at full capacity.
Saudi officials said the attack was carried out by Iran‑backed Iraqi militias using drones, and the pipeline was forced to shut on Thursday last week.

Officials familiar with the situation said repairs to the pipeline and a major pump station are expected to take three to five weeks, though one official noted that a portion of the capacity might remain operational during the repairs.
Bloomberg reported on Monday the 14th that Sparta Commodities SA senior oil market analyst June Goh said, “In the end, everything comes down to how long the shutdown lasts.”

Goh added that if crude transport can be restored quickly, the impact should be limited because inventories at the western end of the pipeline can be drawn upon, but she warned that a prolonged shutdown could force Saudi Arabia to cut production.

DBS Bank energy research head Suvro Sarkar said Saudi’s western‑end inventories can support five to seven days of exports, but if the pipeline outage exceeds that window it would cause “massive disruption.”

items.title: 堅守千億營收目標！博通執行長回應Anthrooic安全警告：AI只是一種工具 算力需求無虞
items.title_en: Sticking to the $100 B Revenue Goal! Broadcom CEO Responds to Anthropic Safety Warning: AI Is Just a Tool, No Threat to Compute Demand
paras: 面對近日市場對AI先進模型研發恐將放緩的擔憂，博通執行長陳福陽週一(14日)受訪時明確表示，這場爭論不會影響博通的長期績效預測，該公司堅守2027財年至2028財年的營收目標不變。
陳福陽此番表態的背景是，Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei上週六(12日)發文主張應放緩頂級AI模型的研發速度，以防範潛在風險，言論得到OpenAI執行長奧特曼及馬斯克等人的關注與討論，導致投資人在周一重新評估算力基礎設施需求，引發科技股震盪。
身為Anthropic最重要的客製化晶片供應商之一，博通股價周一下跌4.8%，iShares半導體ETF亦重挫5.6%。
當被問到是否會因此重新考慮業績預測，陳福陽斬釘截鐵地回應：「不會，一點都不會。」他並指出，無論是用於先進模型研發的算力，還是面向全球市場的「推理」算力，需求都將持續保持旺盛。
回顧博通9月2日發布的財報，陳福陽曾預測AI晶片業務在2027財年營收將達到1150億美元，並在2028財年翻倍至2300億美元，財測數字超出市場預期的目標曾讓博通股價大漲。
陳福陽進一步透露，Anthropic預計在2027年超越谷歌，成為博通最大的客製化晶片客戶，這也解釋了為何博通投資者對Amodei的言論高度敏感。
對於AI產業的發展節奏，陳福陽表現出務實的態度。他認同有必要對AI技術施加一定的治理規則與安全防護，但認為AI「並非會自行失控的活物」。他強調，儘管訓練端的進展難以預判，但一旦涉及產品化應用，推理端的需求將「非常、非常旺盛」。
陳福陽將AI的誕生比喻為18世紀始於英國的工業革命，認為這種工具將極大提升生產力，並推動社會邁向更高層次的生活。在市場對「AI泡沫」的擔憂聲中，這位半導體產業的領導者選擇用長期主義的視角，為算力基礎設施的未來投下信任票。
paras_en: Facing recent market concerns that development of advanced AI models may slow, Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said on Monday (the 14th) that this debate will not affect the company’s long‑term performance outlook, and Broadcom will keep its revenue targets for fiscal 2027‑2028 unchanged.

Tan’s comment came after Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei posted on Saturday (the 12th) urging a slowdown in the development of top‑tier AI models to mitigate potential risks. The remarks drew attention from OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Elon Musk and others, prompting investors on Monday to reassess compute‑infrastructure demand and sparking volatility in tech stocks.
As one of Anthropic’s most important custom‑chip suppliers, Broadcom’s shares fell 4.8% on Monday and the iShares Semiconductor ETF dropped 5.6%.

When asked whether the outlook would be revised, Tan responded unequivocally, “No, not at all.” He added that demand for compute power—whether for advanced model training or for globally‑focused inference—will remain robust.

Looking back at Broadcom’s earnings release on September 2, Tan had forecast AI‑chip revenue of $115 billion in fiscal 2027 and a doubling to $230 billion in fiscal 2028, figures that exceeded market expectations and sent the stock soaring.

Tan further disclosed that Anthropic expects to overtake Google in 2027 to become Broadcom’s largest custom‑chip customer, explaining why Broadcom investors are especially sensitive to Amodei’s comments.

Regarding the pace of AI industry development, Tan took a pragmatic stance. He agreed that some governance rules and safety safeguards are needed, but he said AI “is not a living thing that will run away on its own.” He stressed that while training‑side progress is hard to predict, once products move to deployment, inference demand will be “very, very strong.”

Tan likened the birth of AI to the 18th‑century Industrial Revolution that began in Britain, saying the tool will dramatically boost productivity and push society toward a higher standard of living. Amid worries about an “AI bubble,” the semiconductor leader chose a long‑term perspective, casting a vote of confidence in the future of compute infrastructure.

items.title: 價差逾25%！韓避險基金業者籲三星實施庫藏股計畫並註銷優先股
items.title_en: Spread Over 25%: South Korean Hedge Fund Urges Samsung to Implement Share Buyback and Cancel Preferred Shares
paras: 南韓避險基金業者Life Asset Management最新表示，三星電子應實施庫藏股並註銷優先股，成為首批直接推動該舉措，以期提升公司估值的股東之一。目前，三星優先股價格較普通股折讓超過25%。
在本週致三星董事會和管理層的一封信中，這家總部位於首爾的避險基金呼籲三星回購並註銷優先股，直至其與普通股的價差消除。該基金還要求三星董事會在10月會議上審議該計畫，並在12月底前註銷相關股份。
該基金的呼籲也顯示，在近期公布今年將返還至多110兆韓元(817億美元)計畫以共享AI熱潮帶來的巨額財富後，這家晶片製造商面臨來自股東的更大壓力。
雖然三星尚未完全披露細節，但業內觀察人士已強調，鑑於優先股相對於普通股的大幅折價，應回購優先股。
上述基金業者還表示，在支付特別股息和常規股息後，股東回報方案中至多 73萬億韓元的資金應被用於股票回購。
市場觀察人士預計，鑑於回購優先股更具成本效益，三星將把回購資金的相當一部分用於回購這類股票。
paras_en: South Korean hedge fund manager Life Asset Management said that Samsung Electronics should implement a share buyback and cancel its preferred shares, becoming one of the first shareholders to directly push the measure in order to boost the company’s valuation. Currently, Samsung’s preferred shares trade at a discount of more than 25% to common shares.

In a letter to Samsung’s board and management this week, the Seoul‑based hedge fund called on Samsung to repurchase and cancel its preferred shares until the price gap with common shares disappears. The fund also asked the board to consider the plan at the October meeting and to cancel the relevant shares by the end of December.

The fund’s appeal comes as the chipmaker, after recently announcing a plan to return up to 110 trillion won (about $81.7 billion) this year to share in the massive wealth created by the AI boom, faces even greater pressure from shareholders.

Although Samsung has not fully disclosed details, industry observers have stressed that, given the large discount of the preferred shares relative to common shares, the preferred shares should be repurchased.
The hedge fund also said that, after paying special and regular dividends, up to 73 quadrillion won of funds earmarked for shareholder returns should be used for stock buybacks.
Market watchers expect that, because buying back preferred shares is more cost‑effective, Samsung will allocate a substantial portion of its buyback budget to repurchasing this class of stock.

items.title: 伊朗攻擊暴露波灣AI資料中心風險 AWS機房遇襲逾半年未復原
items.title_en: Iran Attack Exposes Gulf AI Data Center Risks; AWS Facilities Remain Offline Over Six Months
paras: 2026年09月15日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國與以色列對伊朗發動首波攻擊後，伊朗隨即以大量無人機反擊，而波斯灣地區新興的高價值目標之一，正是美國科技公司的資料中心。這場衝突不僅造成雲端服務中斷，更開始動搖阿拉伯聯合大公國等波灣國家打造全球AI運算樞紐的投資邏輯。
根據研調機構Mordor Intelligence，沙烏地阿拉伯資料中心建設市場規模2025年為4.1097億美元，預估2031年增加至42.0043億美元，2026年至2031年年複合成長率為12.3%。資料中心IT負載容量將由2025年的461.71百萬瓦(MW)，增加至2031年的4,811.07百萬瓦。
Amazon(AMZN-US)旗下AWS承諾投資超過53億美元，在沙烏地建立包含3個可用區的雲端區域，規劃2026年商業營運；Oracle(ORCL-US)則宣布投入15億美元擴大沙烏地雲端基礎設施。Microsoft(MSFT-US)也已完成當地3個Azure可用區建設，預計2026年投入營運。
遭到攻擊超過6個月後，亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)旗下Amazon Web Services(AWS)位於阿布達比與巴林的資料中心仍大致處於離線狀態。AWS已要求客戶將資料轉移至其他地區，以等待受損設施完成修復，目前仍未公布全面恢復服務的時間。
長時間停機顯示設施受損程度相當嚴重。目前AWS阿布達比設施仍有超過130項運算服務受到影響，巴林則有140項，兩地各自僅恢復5項服務。
在戰爭爆發前，波灣地區擁有大量土地、政府資金支持，以及較容易取得開發許可等優勢，加上能源供應充裕，一度被視為AI資料中心擴張的重要新據點。然而，當價值數十億甚至數百億美元、且要求高度持續運作的運算基礎設施集中在距離伊朗不到200哩的區域，地緣政治風險已成為投資決策中無法忽略的新變數。

paras_en: September 15, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – After the United States and Israel launched the first wave of attacks on Iran, Iran immediately retaliated with a large swarm of drones. One of the emerging high‑value targets in the Persian Gulf region is the data centers of U.S. technology companies. The conflict has not only caused cloud‑service outages but also begun to undermine the investment logic of Gulf nations such as the United Arab Emirates that are positioning themselves as global AI‑computing hubs.

According to research firm Mordor Intelligence, Saudi Arabia’s data‑center construction market was worth $410.97 million in 2025 and is projected to grow to $4.20043 billion by 2031, with a compound annual growth rate of 12.3% from 2026 to 2031. Data‑center IT load capacity is expected to rise from 461.71 MW in 2025 to 4,811.07 MW in 2031.

Amazon (AMZN‑US) through its AWS unit has pledged to invest more than $5.3 billion to build a cloud region in Saudi Arabia that will include three availability zones, slated for commercial operation in 2026. Oracle (ORCL‑US) announced a $1.5 billion investment to expand its Saudi cloud infrastructure, while Microsoft (MSFT‑US) has completed construction of three Azure availability zones in the kingdom and plans to go live in 2026.

More than six months after the attacks, Amazon’s Amazon Web Services (AWS) data centers in Abu Dhabi and Bahrain remain largely offline. AWS has asked customers to migrate their data to other regions while the damaged facilities are repaired, and it has not yet announced a timeline for full service restoration.

The prolonged outage indicates severe damage to the facilities. Over 130 compute services are still affected at the Abu Dhabi site and 140 at the Bahrain site, with each location having restored only five services so far.

Before the war, the Gulf region was seen as a prime new location for AI data‑center expansion thanks to abundant land, government funding, relatively easy permitting and plentiful energy supplies. However, when multi‑billion‑dollar, continuously‑operating compute infrastructure is concentrated within less than 200 miles of Iran, geopolitical risk has become an unavoidable factor in investment decisions.

paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 剛剛正式啟動預售的iPhone 18 Pro系列，14日（周一）已在中國電商平台上跌破發售價，是蘋果新機連續三年在中國上市即「破發」。
拼多多(PDD-US) 平台百億補貼頁面顯示，原價為人民幣（下同）9,999元的蘋果 iPhone18 Pro全網通5G 雙卡雙待手機256G拼單價為9,699元，同時平台發放600元店鋪券，最終下單價可低至9,099元，較官方發售價降價900元。
據《第一財經》報導，淘寶平台頁面也顯示，中國移動天貓手機官方旗艦店iPhone 18 Pro 「購機直降300元」，店鋪打出了行動用戶下單享300元行動話費活動。
同時已有店鋪顯示，iPhone 18 Pro可參加煥新補貼、以舊換新等優惠補貼，補貼後到手價可至9,099元起。
不過，蘋果官方渠道目前暫無降價優惠，iPhone 18 Pro優惠以限時24期免息為主，且不支持國家補貼和教育優惠。客服表示，具體優惠以商品詳情頁和訂單結算頁面為主。
作為最受關注電商標品之一，蘋果手機是電商展現平台影響力、價格力的競爭熱區。電商對蘋果新機的補貼速度越來越快，從2024年至今，蘋果新機已連續三年在拼多多平台上市即「破發」。
2025年9月15日，蘋果發表會後，拼多多百億補貼就曾啟動iPhone 17系列全面補貼。iPhone 17 256GB券後價可低至5,099元，iPhone 17 Pro 256GB券後價可低至8,099元，各機型券後價格較官方定價便宜900元左右。
2024年9月19日，iPhone16正式發售前，拼多多也一度將iPhone 16價格打到5,399元起，比官網降價600元。
值得關注的是，蘋果首款摺疊機iPhone Duo發表後，「黃牛」針對iPhone Duo、iPhone18系列推出搶購業務，加價可至5,000元。但從蘋果新機連續三年的價格變化來看，電商平台對蘋果新品的優惠補貼也在不斷前移，留給「黃牛」的時間不多了。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has just begun pre‑sales of the iPhone 18 Pro series, and on Monday the 14th it fell below the launch price on Chinese e‑commerce platforms, marking the third straight year that a new Apple phone “breaks” on launch in China.

Pinduoduo (PDD-US) shows on its hundred‑billion‑yuan subsidy page that the iPhone 18 Pro 5G dual‑SIM 256 GB, originally priced at RMB 9,999, is listed for a group‑buy price of RMB 9,699, and the platform also issues a RMB 600 store voucher, bringing the final order price down to as low as RMB 9,099 – a discount of RMB 900 from the official launch price.

According to First Financial, the Taobao page also shows that the China Mobile Tmall official flagship store for the iPhone 18 Pro offers a “direct price cut of RMB 300” and a promotion where mobile users get a RMB 300 mobile‑bill rebate when ordering.
Some stores already indicate that the iPhone 18 Pro can participate in renewal subsidies, trade‑in programs and other discounts, resulting in a post‑subsidy price starting from RMB 9,099.

However, Apple’s official channels currently have no price cuts; the iPhone 18 Pro promotion focuses on a limited‑time 24‑month interest‑free plan and does not support national subsidies or education discounts. Customer service says the specific offers are detailed on the product page and checkout page.

As one of the most watched e‑commerce flagship products, Apple phones are a hot battleground for platforms to showcase influence and pricing power. The speed of subsidies for new Apple devices on e‑commerce sites has accelerated, and since 2024 Apple’s new phones have consecutively “broken” on launch on Pinduoduo for three years.

After Apple’s September 15 2025 event, Pinduoduo’s hundred‑billion‑yuan subsidy launched full subsidies for the iPhone 17 series, with the iPhone 17 256 GB after‑voucher price as low as RMB 5,099 and the iPhone 17 Pro 256 GB as low as RMB 8,099, roughly RMB 900 cheaper than the official pricing.
On September 19 2024, before the official launch of the iPhone 16, Pinduoduo briefly dropped the iPhone 16 price to start at RMB 5,399, about RMB 600 below the official website price.

It is noteworthy that after the debut of Apple’s first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, scalpers have launched rush‑buy services for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 series, inflating prices by up to RMB 5,000. Yet, given the three‑year trend of price drops for new Apple devices, e‑commerce platforms are moving subsidies forward, leaving less time for scalpers.

美伊戰爭的外交斡旋似乎陷入停滯，目前伊朗與其他波斯灣國家的會議遭到延後，加上中東地區船隻遭到攻擊，也進一步加劇市場對石油供應的疑慮。
ING外匯策略師Francesco Pesole說：「波斯灣局勢仍令人擔憂，加上部分與AI相關的消息進一步打壓股市，在這樣的環境下，美元應可持續獲得支撐。」
市場愈來愈確信，Fed將在本周三升息，以因應能源價格跳升。能源價格上漲已推動柴油價格創下歷史新高，也使8月核心通膨升幅高於預期。
芝商所集團(CME Group)的FedWatch工具數據顯示，交易員押注Fed升息的機率約為90%，高於一周前的約60%。
三菱UFJ金融集團(MUFG)資深外匯分析師Lee Hardman說：「本周初美元溫和走強，受到市場對聯準會將開始收緊貨幣政策的預期升溫所提振。」
不過，美元近期走強並非沒有風險。
Scotiabank分析師Shaun Osborne領導的團隊在報告中表示，「如果Fed維持利率不變，將令市場感到意外，並明顯對美元不利。但如果是一次『鴿派升息』，沒有明確承諾將進一步升息，也可能令美元承壓。」
日元走弱　美元重返154日圓上方
日元明顯走弱，近期因市場押注日本銀行(BOJ，央行)升息而出現的強勁漲勢有所收斂。
美元兌日元上揚0.5%至154.355，脫離上周觸及的近七個月低點153下方。
全球升息預期升溫，已推動美國、歐洲及日本債券殖利率升至多年甚至數十年高點。不過，目前對外匯市場的影響相對有限，因各主要市場殖利率大致同步走高。
市場幾乎篤定日銀周五將升息。日元市場情緒也開始轉變，投機客自2月以來首度轉為淨做多日圓。
英國央行(BOE)預期周四將維持利率不變，但交易員如今預期今年稍晚將升息，並在2027年進一步升息。歐洲央行(ECB)上周已升息。
比特幣上漲2%至79152.23美元。

paras_en: The dollar rose against most major currencies on Monday (the 14th), as the Middle East conflict stoked oil prices, prompting investors to flock to the dollar as a safe haven and raising the odds of a Fed rate hike this week, all of which fueled the dollar's advance.
In late New York trading, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.3% to around 99.41, touching 99.735 intraday, the highest since September 2.
The euro fell to a one-month low of $1.153, while the pound also declined 0.2% to $1.3512.

The oil price spike unsettled investors and pushed global bond yields back near multi-year highs. Brent crude at one point surged 5% to $109.80 a barrel before paring gains to close at $105.61 a barrel.

Oil prices have been supported by multiple forces in recent days, the most significant being attacks by the Iran-backed Houthi group on Saudi Arabia, the world's largest oil exporter. Saudi Arabia had previously shut down a major pipeline used to bypass the Strait of Hormuz and reach the Red Sea, and now the Red Sea is also under threat from the Houthis.

Diplomatic mediation in the US-Iran conflict appears to have stalled, with the current meeting between Iran and other Gulf states postponed, and attacks on vessels in the Middle East have further intensified market concerns over oil supply.

ING FX strategist Francesco Pesole said: 'The Gulf situation remains concerning, and some AI-related news has further weighed on equities. In this environment, the dollar should continue to find support.'

The market is growing increasingly confident that the Fed will hike rates this Wednesday in response to the energy price spike. Rising energy prices have already pushed diesel prices to record highs and caused August core inflation to come in above expectations.
Data from CME Group's FedWatch tool shows traders are pricing in roughly a 90% probability of a Fed rate hike, up from about 60% a week earlier.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) senior FX analyst Lee Hardman said: 'The dollar has firmed modestly early this week, buoyed by rising market expectations that the Fed will begin tightening monetary policy.'
However, the dollar's recent strength is not without risks.

A team led by Scotiabank analyst Shaun Osborne noted in a report: 'If the Fed holds rates steady, it would surprise the market and be clearly negative for the dollar. But a "dovish hike" without a clear commitment to further tightening could also put pressure on the dollar.'
Yen Weakens; Dollar Reclaims 154 Yen
The yen weakened noticeably, with its recent strong rally driven by market bets on a Bank of Japan (BOJ) rate hike showing signs of fading.
The dollar-yen pair rose 0.5% to 154.355, moving away from below 153, a near-seven-month low touched last week.

Heating global rate-hike expectations have pushed US, European, and Japanese bond yields to multi-year or even multi-decade highs. However, the impact on the FX market has been relatively limited so far, as yields across major markets have risen roughly in tandem.
The market is nearly certain the BOJ will hike rates on Friday. Yen market sentiment has also begun to shift, with speculators turning net long the yen for the first time since February.

The Bank of England (BOE) is expected to hold rates steady on Thursday, but traders now anticipate a hike later this year and further tightening in 2027. The European Central Bank (ECB) hiked rates last week.

items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Plunges Over 0.1 Unit, Market Awaits as Central Bank Caps Weekly Rate at 31.688
paras: 全球超級央行周登場，受熱錢匯出影響，台北股匯今(14)日連袂走弱，新台幣兌美元一度重貶 1.4 角，但在央行調節下，終場貶勢收斂，以 31.688 元作收，貶值 5 分，市場轉趨觀望，台北及元太外匯市場總成交量縮至 22.755 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.65元，盤中一度重貶 1.41 角，最低來到 31.779 元，不過，整體匯市交易偏冷，在央行稍加調節下，匯價又回到 31.6 字頭，終場收在31.688元、貶值5分，為連續 3 個交易日走貶。
觀察主要貨幣表現，根據央行統計，截至下午4點，美元指數上漲0.44%，主要亞幣互有升貶，新加坡幣貶值0.22%，新台幣貶值0.16%，日元貶0.11%，韓元小貶 0.04%，人民幣則逆勢小升 0.03%。
全球市場本周迎來央行超級周，聯準會(Fed)、日本銀行(BOJ)及英國央行(BOE)將接連公布利率決策。其中，美國通膨與就業數據雙雙偏強，使Fed升息1碼(25個基點)機率突破八成；日銀也可能將利率調升至1.25%。
受中東局勢緊張及AI模型巨頭呼籲放緩產業發展影響，日韓股市午盤後跌勢擴大，台股今日開低震盪，盤中一度重挫786點。隨後在金融股強勢護盤，以及聯電、鴻海先後翻紅的支撐下，跌幅顯著收斂，終場加權指數下跌322.33點，收在45,862.52點，成交金額縮減至6,309.17億元，創下4月8日以來單日新低量。外資今天賣超約 370 億元。
paras_en: Global “super‑central‑bank” week kicked off, and hot‑money outflows weighed on Taipei’s stock and currency markets. On the 14th, the New Taiwan dollar briefly fell 1.4 tenths against the US dollar, but central‑bank intervention narrowed the decline, closing at 31.688 NTD per dollar – a 0.05‑unit depreciation. Trading volume in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market shrank to US$2.2755 billion as the market turned cautious.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.65 NTD per dollar and at one point slipped 1.41 tenths, hitting a low of 31.779 NTD. Overall forex activity was muted, and after a modest central‑bank adjustment the rate rebounded to the 31.6 level, ending the session at 31.688 NTD, down 0.05 units – marking three consecutive days of depreciation.

Looking at major currencies, central‑bank data up to 4 p.m. showed the US dollar index up 0.44%. Among Asian currencies, the Singapore dollar fell 0.22%, the New Taiwan dollar slipped 0.16%, the yen dropped 0.11%, the won edged down 0.04%, while the Chinese yuan rose modestly 0.03% against the dollar.

This week is a “super‑central‑bank” week globally, with the Federal Reserve, Bank of Japan and Bank of England set to announce rate decisions. Strong US inflation and employment data have pushed the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike above 80%, and the BOJ may raise its policy rate to 1.25%.

Tensions in the Middle East and calls from AI‑model giants to slow industry development weighed on Japanese and Korean equities, widening their afternoon declines. Taiwan’s market opened lower and swung sharply, at one point dropping 786 points. However, strong buying in financial stocks and rebounds in UMC and Foxconn helped narrow losses, with the weighted index closing down 322.33 points at 45,862.52, turnover falling to NT$630.917 billion – the lowest single‑day volume since April 8. Foreign investors sold about NT$37 billion today.

items.title: 日央行高層警惕「非線性」通膨衝擊 預期本周將再度升息
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Officials Warn of “Non‑Linear” Inflation Shock, Expect Another Rate Hike This Week
paras: 根據周一(14日)公布的會議紀錄顯示，一位日本央行官員指出，受進口成本上升和匯率波動衝擊影響，日本通膨率急劇攀升，這顯示在貨幣政策決策時，必須將此類價格波動因素納入考量。
上述言論出自日本央行5月主辦的貨幣政策會議。日本央行已於6月將政策利率調升至 1% 的31年新高，並預計在本周再度升息，以因應日益嚴峻的通膨壓力。
央行通常透過升息來抑制需求驅動型通膨。然而，新冠疫情、俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭、美國提高關稅以及中東衝突等事件，使得人們的焦點轉向了供給側通膨。
負責貨幣政策企畫的日央行執行董事中村康治(Koji Nakamura)在會議中指出，日本國內物價對外部衝擊出現了「非線性」反應，消費者物價對進口價格與匯率波動呈現劇烈上揚。他強調，雖然傳統做法是無視供給面衝擊，但若外部衝擊頻繁發生，就不應將其視為暫時現象，因為這會持續推升基底通膨與民眾的通膨預期。
此外，中村表示，日本同時面臨勞動力減少帶動工資上漲的「慢速人口結構衝擊」，此為不可忽視的結構性因素。
自2024年結束長達十年的超寬鬆刺激計畫以來，日央行已承諾將持續升息。當前緊繃的就業市場、日元疲軟導致的進口成本增加，以及中東衝突引發的燃料價格上漲，均加劇了通膨超越 2% 目標的風險。央行未來需將數據分析與實地調查相結合，以更精準掌握企業與家庭行為的改變對通膨預期的影響。
paras_en: According to the minutes released on Monday (the 14th), a Bank of Japan official said that rising import costs and exchange‑rate volatility have caused Japan’s inflation rate to surge sharply, indicating that such price‑fluctuation factors must be taken into account when making monetary‑policy decisions.

The remarks were made at the Bank of Japan’s May monetary‑policy meeting. The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1% in June – a 31‑year high – and expects to hike again this week to cope with mounting inflation pressure.

Central banks usually raise rates to curb demand‑driven inflation. However, events such as the COVID‑19 pandemic, Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, higher U.S. tariffs and Middle‑East conflicts have shifted attention toward supply‑side inflation.

Koji Nakamura, an executive director in charge of monetary‑policy planning, said in the meeting that domestic prices in Japan are reacting “non‑linearly” to external shocks, with consumer prices spiking sharply as import prices and exchange rates fluctuate. He stressed that while the traditional approach is to ignore supply‑side shocks, frequent external shocks should not be treated as temporary, as they will keep pushing up core inflation and inflation expectations.
Nakamura also noted that Japan is simultaneously facing a “slow‑moving demographic shock” – a shrinking labor force that is driving wage growth – which is a structural factor that cannot be ignored.

Since ending a decade‑long ultra‑easy stimulus program at the end of 2024, the BOJ has pledged to keep raising rates. A tight labour market, a weak yen that raises import costs, and higher fuel prices from Middle‑East conflicts all heighten the risk of inflation exceeding the 2% target. The bank will need to combine data analysis with on‑the‑ground surveys to more accurately gauge how changes in corporate and household behaviour affect inflation expectations.

items.title: 聯準會升息預期升溫推升美元 亞幣普遍走弱、日元維持7個月高位
items.title_en: Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations Heat Up, Boosting the Dollar; Asian Currencies Mostly Weaker, Yen Holds Near 7‑Month High
paras: 受市場對美國聯準會本周升息預期大幅上升影響，美元強勢走高，亞洲貨幣周一(14日)普遍對美元走弱。然而，由於市場押注日本銀行(BOJ)將加速緊縮貨幣政策，日元表現相對堅挺，維持在接近7個月的高位附近。
在美國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)加速上漲後，根據 CME FedWatch 工具顯示，市場目前預估聯準會在9月16日會議升息的機率已升至 86%。升息預期的劇增帶動美元指數上漲0.2%至99.35附近，結束了連續兩周的微幅下跌。
美債殖利率同步受到支撐，10年期美債殖利率來到約4.97%，而對政策利率極為敏感的2年期美債殖利率則保持在4.6%以上。
本周全球金融市場迎來關鍵的「超級央行周」，聯準會、英國央行與日本央行將接連公布最新利率決策。市場目前已幾乎完全消化日本銀行周五將升息25個基點(0.25%)的預期，加上投資人預計日本海外資產可能回流，帶動日元本月累積上漲約 4%。
目前美元對日元交投於154.03附近，維持在接近上周創下的2月以來最高點152.89附近，投機客自2月以來首次轉為淨多頭。
在其他主要貨幣方面，歐元對美元下跌0.3%至1.1564，英鎊對美元下跌0.2%至1.3501。亞幣與周邊貨幣普遍承壓，美元對澳元上漲0.4%、對韓元上漲0.25%、對新加坡元上漲0.16%，紐元對美元則下跌0.5%。人民幣表現相對平穩，美元對離岸人民幣微升0.01%至6.7080，印度市場則因國定假日休市。
此外，中東地區的新衝突引發供應疑慮，布蘭特原油期貨大漲近3%至每桶107.60美元。油價持續穩居100美元上方，恐使能源通膨居高不下，進一步增添各國央行在制定利率政策時的複雜度與考驗。
paras_en: The dollar surged as market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike this week rose sharply, causing Asian currencies to generally weaken against the dollar on Monday (the 14th). However, because markets are betting that the Bank of Japan will accelerate its monetary tightening, the yen remained relatively firm, staying near a seven‑month high.

After the U.S. August consumer price index (CPI) accelerated, the CME FedWatch tool showed that the market now estimates an 86% probability that the Fed will raise rates at its September 16 meeting. The surge in rate‑hike expectations lifted the dollar index by 0.2% to around 99.35, ending two weeks of modest declines.
U.S. Treasury yields were supported as well, with the 10‑year yield around 4.97% and the policy‑sensitive 2‑year yield staying above 4.6%.

This week marks a pivotal “super central‑bank week” as the Fed, the Bank of England and the Bank of Japan are set to announce their latest rate decisions. The market has almost fully priced in the BOJ’s expected 25‑basis‑point (0.25%) hike on Friday, and investors anticipate possible repatriation of Japanese overseas assets, driving the yen up about 4% cumulatively this month.
The dollar‑yen pair is trading near 154.03, close to the February‑to‑present peak of 152.89 set last week, with speculators turning net long on the yen for the first time since February.

Among other major currencies, the euro fell 0.3% to $1.1564 and the pound slipped 0.2% to $1.3501. Asian and regional currencies were broadly under pressure: the dollar rose 0.4% against the Australian dollar, 0.25% against the Korean won, and 0.16% against the Singapore dollar, while the New Zealand dollar fell 0.5% versus the dollar. The renminbi was relatively stable, with the offshore yuan edging up 0.01% to 6.7080, and Indian markets were closed for a public holiday.

A new conflict in the Middle East sparked supply concerns, sending Brent crude futures up nearly 3% to $107.60 a barrel. Oil prices staying above $100 a barrel could keep energy‑related inflation high, adding further complexity and challenges for central banks as they set interest‑rate policy.

items.title: 金磚峰會與南方六國首度接入CIPS 人民幣國際支付再擴容
items.title_en: BRICS Summit and Six Southern Nations Join CIPS for the First Time, Expanding RMB International Payments
paras: 2026年9月，全球跨境支付體系出現新動態。第十八屆金磚國家峰會於新德里落幕，會議明確提出深化金磚國家（BRICS）跨境支付合作，推動成員國本土支付系統互聯互通並擴大本幣結算規模。同時，在廈門舉行的第二屆 CIPS 跨境銀企合作活動中，盧安達、土耳其、烏茲別克、馬爾地夫、馬來西亞及喬治亞等六國金融機構首次接入人民幣跨境支付系統（CIPS）。
根據活動數據，期間共有 11 家外資銀行簽署成為 CIPS 直接參與者，4 家境外銀行與 14 家境內銀行完成直參上線。
截至目前，CIPS 參與者已覆蓋全球 133 個國家與地區，服務約 192 個國家和地區的 5,300 家法人銀行，近期單日交易額突破 1.22 兆元人民幣。此外，星展銀行（新加坡）作為首家直連的新加坡銀行，試運行以來累計處理 240 億元人民幣支付；渣打香港則完成了 CIPS 與網聯清算系統的對接，整合跨境與零售支付。
中國國家金融與發展實驗室理事楊濤指出，加強支付合作可降低對美元及西方主導之 SWIFT 體系的依賴，強化金融自主性與抗制裁韌性。他分析，最切合實際的路徑是由雙邊合作逐步擴展至多邊機制。
上海金融研究院副院長劉曉春表示，經由美國清算銀行及 CHIPS 系統進行的美元清算，均處於美國監管視角下。他認為，相較於重新建構獨立的訊息傳遞網路，擴建現有的 CIPS 系統更具可行性。此外，劉曉春評估，在當前各國經濟差異下，推動統一的金磚貨幣並不現實。
中金公司首席經濟學家苗延亮指出，數位人民幣（e-CNY）的可程式化特性有利於大額跨境結算。多邊央行數位貨幣平台 mBridge 截至 2025 年底累計交易額已近 5,000 億元人民幣，其中逾 95% 採用數位人民幣
。然而，苗延亮也提醒，跨管轄區的技術標準與合規體系互通性仍是主要挑戰。
楊濤表示，各國金融體系差異、反洗錢與打擊資恐（AML/CFT）規範不同，以及地緣政治因素，均可能放緩合作落地步調。
劉曉春強調，推動支付合作的關鍵在於尊重市場與商業偏好，而非透過行政手段指定特定貨幣或系統，以利促進區域經貿發展。
paras_en: In September 2026, a new development emerged in the global cross‑border payment system. The 18th BRICS summit concluded in New Delhi, explicitly calling for deeper cross‑border payment cooperation among BRICS members, promoting interconnection of domestic payment systems and expanding settlement in local currencies. At the same time, during the second CIPS cross‑border bank‑enterprise cooperation event in Xiamen, financial institutions from six countries—Rwanda, Turkey, Uzbekistan, the Maldives, Malaysia and Georgia—connected to the People’s Republic of China’s cross‑border payment system (CIPS) for the first time.
According to the event data, a total of 11 foreign‑owned banks signed up to become direct participants in CIPS, while 4 overseas banks and 14 domestic banks completed direct‑participation onboarding.

To date, CIPS participants cover 133 countries and regions worldwide, serving about 5,300 corporate banks in roughly 192 countries and regions. Recent single‑day transaction volume has surpassed RMB 1.22 trillion. Moreover, DBS Bank (Singapore), the first Singapore bank with direct connectivity, has processed RMB 240 billion in payments since its trial launch, and Standard Chartered Hong Kong has completed integration of CIPS with the domestic clearing system, linking cross‑border and retail payments.

Yang Tao, director of China’s National Financial and Development Laboratory, noted that strengthening payment cooperation can reduce reliance on the US‑dominated SWIFT system and the dollar, enhancing financial autonomy and resilience against sanctions. He argued that the most practical path is to expand from bilateral cooperation to multilateral mechanisms.

Liu Xiaochun, vice president of the Shanghai Institute of Financial Research, pointed out that dollar clearing through the US clearing bank and the CHIPS system is subject to US regulatory oversight. He believes that expanding the existing CIPS network is more feasible than building an independent messaging network from scratch, and he assesses that, given current economic disparities, a unified BRICS currency is unrealistic.

Miao Yanliang, chief economist at CICC, highlighted that the programmable nature of the digital yuan (e‑CNY) is advantageous for large‑scale cross‑border settlements. The multilateral central‑bank digital currency platform mBridge has accumulated nearly RMB 500 billion in transaction volume by the end of 2025, with over 95% of that volume using digital yuan.
However, Miao also warned that technical standards and regulatory interoperability across jurisdictions remain major challenges.
Yang Tao added that differences in national financial systems, varying AML/CFT regulations, and geopolitical factors could all slow the pace of cooperation implementation.

Liu Xiaochun emphasized that the key to advancing payment cooperation is respecting market and commercial preferences rather than imposing specific currencies or systems through administrative means, thereby fostering regional trade and economic development.

items.title: 車廠兩難！Stellantis執行長：全球車市分化為「美國」與「其他地區」
items.title_en: Car Makers in a Dilemma! Stellantis CEO: Global Auto Market Split into "USA" and "Other Regions"
paras: Stellantis集團執行長Antonio Filosa上週四(10日)在一場分析師會議上指出，當前全球汽車市場已明顯分化為兩部分：美國與世界其他地區。
Stellantis正面臨美歐等地貿易及政策環境日益分化的挑戰，尤其是與中國企業的合作模式差異顯著。
Filosa強調，美國是Stellantis最主要的利潤來源，但當地法規與消費者需求與其他市場截然不同，如何為美國開發車款成為核心難題。因此，Stellantis在美國完全依賴本土工程與研發力量，但在歐洲等其他市場，則選擇與零跑、東風等中國車廠合作。
值得注意的是，這些合作明確表示不涉及面向美國市場的車型規劃。此前，採取類似模式的福特已遭到白宮抨擊。
美國政府官員批評福特與吉利在歐洲成立合資企業，認為此舉是在幫助中國車場擴大全球業務。福特則回應指合作是為了適應新的全球現實，旨在讓業務更精幹、更有效率。
隨著全球汽車產業格局加速重構，個各車廠如何在分化市場中平衡區域策略，將成為產業共同面臨的考驗。
paras_en: Stellantis Group CEO Antonio Filosa said last Thursday (the 10th) at an analyst meeting that the current global automotive market has clearly divided into two parts: the United States and the rest of the world.
Stellantis is facing increasingly divergent trade and policy environments in places like the US and Europe, especially as its cooperation models with Chinese companies differ markedly.

Filosa emphasized that the United States is Stellantis’s biggest profit source, but local regulations and consumer demand are completely different from other markets, making the development of US‑specific models a core challenge. Consequently, Stellantis relies entirely on domestic engineering and R&D in the US, while in Europe and other regions it chooses to partner with Chinese automakers such as Leapmotor and Dongfeng.
It is noteworthy that these partnerships explicitly state they do not involve vehicle planning for the US market. Previously, Ford, which used a similar model, was criticized by the White House.

US officials criticized Ford and Geely for setting up a joint venture in Europe, saying the move helps Chinese automakers expand globally. Ford responded that the cooperation is meant to adapt to a new global reality, aiming to make its business leaner and more efficient.
As the global automotive industry’s structure rapidly reshapes, how each automaker balances regional strategies in a divided market will become a common challenge for the sector.
